text: 44，年底就44周岁。
en: 44 — I'll be 44 by the end of the year.

text: 健康是第一位的，
en: Health comes first,

text: 作自己开心的事情，
en: do the things that make me happy,

text: 多培养些自己的兴趣爱好，
en: cultivate more of my own interests and hobbies,

text: 不想再看别人的脸色，
en: don't want to have to mind other people's moods any more,

text: 多运动，
en: exercise more,

text: 把孩子好好教育好，
en: bring the children up well,

text: 爱老婆爱孩子！
en: love my wife and love my children!

text: 先想这么多。
en: That's all I can think of for now.

text: 不知道别人的40岁是怎样的，说说自己吧，39岁，上有三老，下有三小，我姐妹俩，老公兄弟仨，坐标十八线小县城。
en: I don't know what others' forties are like; let me speak for myself. I'm 39, with three elders above and three little ones below, my sister and I are two sisters, my husband and his two brothers are three brothers, based in a tiny, remote county town.

text: 不说大家都看得见的中年危机啊压力崩溃了。
en: I won't dwell on the midlife crisis, the stress and the breaking point that everyone can already see.

text: 说说现在的感觉吧，就是我好像没有自我了。
en: Let me talk about how I feel now — it's as if I've lost my self.

text: 上班忙工作，下班路上要想好晚饭吃啥，孩子要辅导啥，回家就要像陀螺一样转，要不然时间根本不够用。
en: I'm busy with work during the day; on the way home I have to work out what's for dinner and what the children need help with; once home I spin like a top — otherwise there simply isn't enough time.

text: 好不容易盼到周末想放松一下，琢磨点自己的事，父母有事又需要你，亲戚间的人情往来需要到场。
en: Having finally made it to the weekend wanting to relax a bit and think about my own things, my parents need me for something again, and the social obligations among relatives require my presence.

text: 有一个词“心力交瘁”，我特别佩服发明这个词的人，真的，我觉得这个词形容了大多数中年人。
en: There's a phrase, 'worn out in both body and mind', and I really admire whoever coined it; honestly, I think it describes most middle-aged people.

text: 尤其疫情影响下的这几年，赚钱的压力是实实在在的，花钱的地方却有增无减。
en: Particularly in these years under the impact of the pandemic, the pressure to make money is all too real, while the things that cost money only keep growing.

text: 以前总是憧憬着孩子大了，结婚了，现在从不想这些，因为眼下的生活已经快让人招架不住了，哪有精力想那么远。
en: I used to always look forward to the children growing up and getting married, but now I never think about such things, because daily life is already almost more than I can bear — how could I have the energy to think that far ahead.

text: 心力交瘁的中年人，每天都在被迫自愈，真的是被迫，撑不住的时候连死的想法都不敢有，因为后面有一大帮人靠着你。
en: The drained middle-aged person is forced to heal themselves every day — truly forced; even when they can't hold on, they dare not even think of death, because there's a whole crowd of people behind them relying on them.

text: 一个家庭就像一直队伍，我们从最后一名慢慢长成第一名，然后再慢慢老到我们的孩子身后，生活的接力棒就这样一辈一辈往下传，生命就这样一代一代繁衍生息。
en: A family is like a team; we slowly grow from being last to being first, then slowly grow old to behind our children; the baton of life is passed down from generation to generation like this, and life reproduces and continues from one generation to the next.

text: 责任，担当，使命，这个年龄，上有老，下有小，一个家庭中的中坚力量，核心支柱。
en: Responsibility, commitment, mission — at this age, with the old above and the young below, the mainstay and central pillar of a family.

text: 赚钱养家是主要作为，确保日常生活开支及家庭成员的幸福保障。
en: Making money to support the family is the principal role, ensuring daily living costs and the happiness and security of family members.

text: 这一切的一切，都需要靠自己去创造，把控。
en: All of this, every last bit of it, needs to be created and kept under control by oneself.

text: 没有什么可依靠依赖，去拼搏去努力，维护维持家庭的大团结小幸运，大健康小美
en: There is nothing to lean on or depend on; go and fight and strive, uphold the family's great solidarity and small blessings, great health and little joys.

text: 开始不断的告别
en: Beginning the endless goodbyes.

text: 年轻时的爱情(没有走到一起)，离开这个世界了
en: The love from my youth (we never ended up together) has left this world.

text: 毕业后养的猫咪，在20年的时候，一只生病走了，一只离家再也不回来了
en: The cat I kept after graduating — in 2020, one got sick and passed away, and one ran away from home and never returned.

text: 外公去年去世了，公公去年去世了，高中同学去年去世了
en: My grandfather (mother's side) died last year, my father-in-law died last year, and a high school classmate died last year.

text: 不断的告别，不愿意，但是得习惯
en: Constant goodbyes — unwilling, but one has to get used to them.

text: 想到这些，就很down
en: Thinking of all this, I feel really down.

text: 每个人肯定不一样的体会，事业有成的，正好处于最好的年龄，事业继续上升，老人孩子都非常幸福，阖家欢乐。
en: Everyone surely has a different experience; those who have succeeded in their careers are right at their best age, their careers still on the rise, their elders and children all very happy, the whole family cheerful.

text: 如果事业一般，基本人生到了巅峰，就不要把精力放在事业上了，放在家庭和身体上，好好享受简单的生活，都很好。
en: If one's career is average and one has essentially reached the peak of life, then don't put your energy into your career; put it into family and health, and enjoy the simple life properly — it's all fine.

text: 最好的时候或者接近你人生巅峰的阶段。
en: The best of times, or the stage close to the peak of your life.

text: 有子女，有父母，自己有配偶，有事业，有产业，有基础，知道在干嘛，想干嘛，能干嘛。
en: With children, with parents, with a spouse of your own, with a career, with property, with a foundation — knowing what you're doing, what you want to do, what you're able to do.

text: 很多人都感慨没有20岁或者30岁如何如何干练了，一点都不是的，更不必遗憾难过什么。
en: Many people lament that they're no longer as sharp and capable as they were at twenty or thirty; that's not the case at all, and there's certainly no need to regret or feel sad about anything.

text: 什么年轻漂亮女孩子围着你转的时候过去了，过去了就过去吧，大叔我过去可比现在跑来嘲笑我的犊子们精彩多了，现在更是通透多了。
en: The time when young, pretty girls flocked around you is over — and what's over is over. Old Uncle me, my past was far more colourful than these little whippersnappers who now come to mock me, and now I'm even more clear-headed.

text: 玩得那些换了形式而已，很多还不如过去，现在更多的就把无聊和冲动当做刺激和兴趣，我现在早走10年，你们晚走10年，20年也要到我这个年龄，等你们。
en: The things we used to get up to have merely changed form; many aren't as good as in the past. Now we mostly take boredom and impulse for thrills and interest. I set off ten years earlier, you set off ten years later; in twenty years you'll be my age too — I'll be waiting for you.

text: 至于我的同龄人们如果还达不到我的状态，那可真的是可惜了。
en: As for my contemporaries, if they still haven't reached my state of being, that would really be a shame.

text: 在这个物欲纷飞的世界，我们每个人都充满了焦虑，以前看过小品《昨天，今天，明天》，可现在，又有几个人能静下心来，回忆昨天。
en: In this world of rampant materialism, we are each full of anxiety. I once watched the skit 'Yesterday, Today, Tomorrow', but now, how many people can sit down quietly and recall yesterday.

text: 我们大部分，都迫于工作的烦心，房贷的压力，上有老下有小，只顾专注于当下，低头努力，却忘了时常回顾和规划。
en: Most of us, compelled by the annoyances of work and the pressure of the mortgage, with the old above and the young below, only focus on the here and now, heads down, striving hard, yet forgetting to look back and plan from time to time.

text: 看着身边人一个一个在变得更好，自己的努力却没有回报，压力逐渐转变成焦虑，焦虑越多，就会迫使想要去做的更多，反而样样做不好。
en: Watching the people around us get better one by one, while our own efforts go unrewarded, pressure gradually turns into anxiety; the more anxiety there is, the more it compels one to want to do more — yet in the end nothing is done well.

text: 在这里呢，建议大家学会有所专注，不要一心“求全”。
en: Here, I'd advise everyone to learn to focus on something, and not to be bent on 'having it all'.

text: 找到自己心爱的事情，努力付出，不求回报，一心钟爱，或许带来预期外的正向反馈。
en: Find the thing you love, put in the effort, expect no reward, devote yourself to it wholeheartedly, and perhaps it will bring unexpected positive feedback.

text: 晚安，各位～
en: Good night, everyone~

text: 比二三十岁自由 二三十岁可能还想着努力 现在更多的是满足自己的需求 身体上 精神上 把自己照顾的很好 开开心心 不强迫自己 得瑟一下自己租的房子 刚搬进来 叫那啥 房子是租的 生活不是 一个人的幸福时光 哈哈哈哈
en: Freer than in my twenties or thirties. At twenty or thirty you might still be thinking about striving; now it's more about satisfying your own needs — physically and mentally, taking good care of yourself, happy, not forcing yourself. Let me show off a bit the flat I'm renting — I just moved in. What's it called… the flat is rented, but life isn't; a happy time for one person. Hahahaha

text: 比上不足比下有余。
en: Worse off than those above, better off than those below.

text: 家里的所有的装修和家具家电，都和自己的身体一样，亚健康状态。
en: All the decorating, furniture and appliances in the home are, like one's own body, in a sub-healthy condition.

text: 想换掉，也是一笔不小的开支。
en: Wanting to replace them would also be no small outlay.

text: 不换，真的不喜欢了不方便了。
en: If I don't replace them, I really don't like them any more and they're inconvenient.

text: 难道当时的将就还要用一辈子啊。
en: Surely the compromise I made back then isn't meant to last a lifetime.

text: 赚钱不就是为了生活方便吗？
en: Isn't earning money precisely so that life is more convenient?

text: 花掉的钱才属于自己的钱。
en: Only the money you spend is money that truly belongs to you.

text: 孩子五六年级的时候，是开始正式用心学习的时候。
en: When the children are in years five and six, that's when they start to study properly.

text: 一二三年级可以不用心，但中高年级内容偏多偏深，开始真正的知识学习，需要家长的辅导。
en: In years one to three you needn't be so serious, but the middle and upper years are heavier and deeper in content, beginning real learning of knowledge, and need the parents' guidance.

text: 工作时间不合适，总会错过与孩子相处的时间。
en: Unsuitable working hours mean you always miss the time to spend with the children.

text: 换工作没那么容易，总想着时间合适挣钱多的工作，但能力不够。
en: Changing jobs isn't so easy; one always wants a job with the right hours and good pay, but one's ability falls short.

text: 失业中的压力就像在苦海中挣扎。
en: The pressure of unemployment is like struggling in a sea of suffering.

text: 所以又退而求其次。
en: So once again one settles for second best.

text: 综上两种情况，40岁的人生体会就是学会将就。
en: To sum up these two situations, the life insight at forty is to learn to make do.

text: 心中有不甘，有目标，有动力。
en: There is reluctance in the heart, along with goals and drive.

text: 尘世间美好和不堪已经走过泰半，舍不得也留不住曾经的青春，活力和情感。
en: I have already walked more than halfway through the beauty and the squalor of this world; unwilling to let go yet unable to keep the youth, vitality and feeling of the past.

text: 跌跌撞撞中学会取舍，欣赏，妥协，不强求。
en: Through the stumbling, I've learned to choose, to appreciate, to compromise, and not to insist.

text: 责任有时让我窒息却又不得不前行。
en: Responsibility sometimes suffocates me, yet I have no choice but to press on.

text: 终于没人关注才开始努力让自己光彩照人。
en: Only once no one is paying attention do I begin to make an effort to make myself shine.

text: 按部就班中抓不住指缝间流走的每一天，不得不沉淀下来去沉迷寻常的小确幸。
en: In going through the motions, I can't hold on to the days slipping through my fingers, and have no choice but to settle down and lose myself in the ordinary little certain joys.

text: 怎么说呢，中年挺好的。
en: How can I put it — middle age is rather nice.

text: 走过无知无畏的莽撞，带着皱纹的从容淡定也不错。
en: Having passed through the ignorant, fearless recklessness of youth, the composed calm that comes with wrinkles is not bad either.

text: 中年人真没什么值得大喜大悲的，父母老去离去孩子长大飞走。
en: There's truly nothing for a middle-aged person to be wildly happy or sad about — parents grow old and pass, children grow up and fly away.

text: 生老病死求不得留不住，都要经历吧。
en: Birth, aging, illness and death cannot be sought or held on to; we must all go through them.
